name: Discrete Diode — 3.3V — SOT
description: 22 tier-A SMD diode parts for the 3.3V facet, largely PESD3V3L-series parts from the Power_Protection group, spanning SOT-family footprints (SOT-363, SOT-886, SOT-323, SOT-353, SOT-665, SOT-666, SOT-89-3, SOT-223-3, SOT-143).
selection_hints: Match the exact SOT footprint variant (e.g. SOT-886 vs SOT-363) to the intended PCB land pattern.
Prefer parts sourced from kicad-symbols over Alternate-KiCad-Library when trust/provenance matters.
Use part name (PESD3V3L...) to distinguish otherwise similar tier-A entries.
All 22 parts are tier A, so differentiate by footprint and part name, not by tier.
avoid_when: The board requires a non-SOT package (e.g. SOD, DO-214, THT leaded).
The required voltage rating differs from the 3.3V facet.
Exact pin/footprint mapping for the chosen SOT variant hasn't been verified against a datasheet.
Electrical function beyond what's stated here (e.g. specific current/clamping ratings) must be confirmed.
